studies.title: The Library of Alexandria
studies.caption: The Ptolemies gather every book they can find, copying the scrolls of ships in the harbour, into a library beside the Museum.
studies.prompt: Interior working room in Hellenistic Alexandria about290BCE, a seated copyist unrolling papyrus on a low table, pigeonholes of cylindrical scrolls, another attendant carrying a bundle. Intimate side view; plain plaster and columns, no modern library shelves, bound books, or invented monumental hall.
